search_text: published ZDI-26-122 ZDI-CAN-27788 PDF-XChange Editor TrackerUpdate Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2026-02-19 CVE-2026-2040 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-2040 7.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['PDF-XChange'] ['PDF-XChange Editor'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of PDF-XChange Editor. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TrackerUpdate process. The product loads a library from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of a target user. Fixed in version 10.7.3.401 https://www.pdf-xchange.com/product/pdf-xchange-editor/history#10.7.3.401 ['2025-09-16 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2026-02-19 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2026-02-19 - Advisory Updated'] Kolja Grassmann (Neodyme AG) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-26-122/
title: PDF-XChange Editor TrackerUpdate Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of PDF-XChange Editor. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the TrackerUpdate process. The product loads a library from an unsecured location. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute code in the context of a target user.
